question: Should OpenClaw sponsor this narrow test-only PR as an exception to CONTRIBUTING.md because it stabilizes maintainer prepare workflows?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound and useful, but repository policy normally rejects this PR category and the protected maintainer label reserves that exception decision for a human owner.

options.title: Sponsor and refresh
options.body: Approve the test-only exception, rebase onto current main, rerun the four focused test files, and land if the exact refreshed head remains green.

options.title: Close under policy
options.body: Close the PR without adopting its test changes because known-main test stabilization should be handled through maintainer-directed work rather than an unsolicited test-only contribution.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and refresh
recommendation.body: Approve the test-only exception, rebase onto current main, rerun the four focused test files, and land if the exact refreshed head remains green.

likelyOwner.reason: Root ownership and contribution-policy interpretation make this the strongest available routing candidate for the exception decision.
